description:
[Deterministic international trade rules engine. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Allocates transport costs, marine cargo insurance, export/import customs clearance fees, terminal handling charges, and exact legal transfer of risk points across all 11 official ICC Incoterms 2020 rules (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP, FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF).
Usage: Use this tool to compare seller vs buyer cost responsibilities and risk handoff milestones in international commercial contracts.
Returns: JSON object with { incoterm: string, sellerCostEur: number, buyerCostEur: number, riskTransferPoint: string, mandatoryInsuranceRequired: boolean, costBreakdown: object }.

destinationTerminalHandlingEur.description: Destination port terminal handling charges (THC) in EUR

exportCustomsClearanceEur.description: Export customs declarations and duties in EUR

finalInlandDeliveryEur.description: Final inland delivery transport to buyer premises in EUR

importDutiesAndTaxesEur.description: Destination import customs duties and clearance fees in EUR

inlandFreightOriginEur.description: Inland transport to origin port/terminal in EUR

internationalMainFreightEur.description: International main carriage freight in EUR

namedPlace.description: Named port or place of destination/delivery (e.g. Port of Rotterdam, Milan Warehouse)

name: incoterms_cost_allocator
title: Incoterms® 2020 Landed Cost & Risk Allocator
